reason: The cited evidence (E1-E4) discusses strain rate effects, adiabatic shear bands, and properties of various HEAs, but none of it addresses the effects of grain refinement on the specific HfZrTiTa0.53 alloy or provides direct support for the key premises linking grain refinement to improved dynamic properties.
premises: Grain refinement increases grain boundary density in RHEAs.
Increased grain boundary density enhances strain hardening in RHEAs.
Enhanced strain hardening reduces adiabatic shear band formation in RHEAs.
Reducing adiabatic shear bands improves uniform deformability and localization resistance under dynamic loading.
Grain refinement leads to simultaneous improvement in strength and ductility under dynamic loading.
